source: Interaction Web Database Olesen et al. 2002
source_data_statement: Positive integers are observed visit frequencies; zeros are no observed interaction.
matrix_orientation: IWDB text matrices: pollinator rows x plant columns; analysis transposes to plant rows x pollinator columns.
claim_boundary: The original IWDB frequency matrices are weighted visitation networks, not pollinator effectiveness or reproductive success. Source-native Shannon interaction diversity and Morisita-Horn plant niche overlap are transparent analogues; they are not asserted to be numerically identical to a published package-specific global estimator unless that estimator is separately verified.
